A '''plascast ''' was a type of medical cast used to support and protect injured or damaged body parts. It could be applied to different areas of the body, including the forearm<ref name="COD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> and nose.<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>
